Hi Liam — thanks for the quick report and the screenshot. I reproduced a similar flow in our staging tenant and saw repeated Set-Cookie headers where the path was being set to "/" but the SameSite attribute was missing; Ariba recently tightened behavior that requires SameSite=None for cross-site callbacks.

Two quick asks:
1) Try this temporary one-time URL (expires 6 hours): https://onboard.redwood.ai/temp/one-time?tok=abc123xyz — it forces a fresh session and bypasses the client-side redirect.
2) If that doesn't work, please open the browser dev tools -> Network, reproduce the flow and send me the full redirect trace. Your screenshot was helpful but I need the 302/Set-Cookie sequence (I've attached our staging session trace for reference: session-debug-20261116.zip).

I'll also open a ticket with Ariba (cc'd) to confirm whether their callback includes SameSite=None or if their proxy strips attributes.

Thanks everyone for the quick investigation. Update: Ben confirmed in staging that our edge CDN was stripping SameSite=None when a strict cookie policy was enabled at the CDN edge. We rolled a hotfix to pass Set-Cookie attributes through for the Ariba callback path and validated with Liam's trace — vendor was able to complete the tax form and reached the "Activation complete" page.

Action items / next steps:
- Ben to add an explicit rule in infra to preserve Set-Cookie attributes for all /ariba/callback endpoints (JIRA SUP-9823).
